title: Percentage (Intro)
description: Class 5 IMO — Introduction to percentage: meaning of percent, converting between fractions, decimals and percentages, finding a percentage of a number, and real-life problems.

topics.title: Meaning of Percent & Conversions
topics.concept:
Percent means 'out of 100'. So 50% means 50 out of 100, which equals ½ or 0.5.

To change a fraction or decimal to a percentage, multiply by 100 (¼ = 25%, 0.3 = 30%). To change a percentage to a fraction or decimal, divide by 100 (20% = 20/100 = ⅕ = 0.2).
recap: Fraction/decimal to % : multiply by 100; % to fraction/decimal: divide by 100.

quiz.q: Write 25% as a fraction in simplest form.

topics.title: Percentage of a Number
topics.concept:
To find a percentage of a number, change the percentage to a fraction or decimal, then multiply. For example, 25% of 80 = (25/100) × 80 = 20.

A quick way: 10% of a number is found by dividing by 10, so 10% of 200 = 20.
recap: Percentage of a number: change % to a fraction/decimal, then multiply.

topics.title: Percentage in Real Life
topics.concept: Percentages appear in discounts and marks. A 20% discount on ₹500 means ₹100 off (so you pay ₹400). Scoring 45 out of 50 means (45/50) × 100 = 90%.

examples.problem: A ₹500 item has a 20% discount. How much is taken off?
A student scores 45 out of 50. What percentage is that?

recap: Discount = percentage of the price taken off.

quiz.q: A ₹200 item has a 10% discount. How much is taken off?
A student scores 18 out of 20. What percentage is that?

questions.explanation: 100% means all of it — the whole number.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three equal 50%)?
questions.explanation: ¼ = 25%, not 50%; the other three equal 50%.
